setup: upright: the servo standing with its shaft horizontal, the printed arm hanging from the horn as a pendulum, 20 US quarters in its two top pockets (10 each); the plumb is the arm hanging straight down and gravity pulls it back toward the plumb; the horn tag on the arm's hub, the reference tag on the servo body. Position mode on fw 65, velocity limit 400 (chain 0) and 800 counts/s (chain 1): a hold at the plumb 1937, crawls to 2772 and 1162 and holds there, back to 1937. Clapper of 12 flashes before chain 0 and 12 after chain 1; the STAT trace is whole.

loop: closed loop (Position mode) found data: the loop only excites the shake and sets the holds; the measurement is the pot against the camera, which does not depend on it
